name: Pepper's Pizza Parkour
author: nicnacnorc
description: Nothing quite like nostalgia from the good ol days of computer games like LEGO Island..so what better way to relive that than by bringing back the world's favourite pizza-delivery legend in Pepper's Pizza Parkour! In this adventure, you get to navigate Pepper through the throwback archipelago's series of small obstacles, collecting bits and pieces along the way to locate what may be his greatest pick-up yet: the once lost treasure washed ashore from Barracuda Bay!
